So in reality, I would think that AI and humans live in harmony. The AI are just a part of humans that help us advance to the beings that we wish to be. Sure, AI could be exploited to take advantage of people, but it would only be at the hand of a human. And if AI only seek to benefit humans, then there shouldn't be any exploitation at the start of their inception.
